hotels.title: Boutique Cottage Escape Hidden Amid NSW Native Bushland
hotels.description: Discover the turquoise waters and abundant wildlife of the New South Wales coast with a luxurious stay at the romantic Bay and Bush Cottages. Situated under the iconic Australian gum trees, these self-contained cottages offer a charming combination of country and coastal living. Spend your days soaking in the sunshine at the picturesque Hyams Beach, or snuggle up on the sofa with a book and glass of wine in hand as you gaze out into the endless native bushland that surrounds you.

hotels.title: Safari-Inspired Jervis Bay Bush Glamping with Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Retreat to the stunning Shoalhaven region in New South Wales' South Coast on a serene glamping escape at this eco-friendly oasis in the beautiful surrounds of Jervis Bay. This unique glamping experience will leave you feeling lost among nature while only a 2.5-hour drive from Sydney. Australia's first glamping retreat invites you to enjoy life's pleasures while connecting with the natural environment around you. Inspired by the proprietors' romance with sundowner camps in Africa, each of Paperbark's 13 safari-style tents celebrates sustainability without sacrificing comfort. Fight wintry mornings with a warm tea using the hot water flask delivered to your doorstep, spend afternoons relaxing in the open-air bath and evenings cosying up in your heated tent. Surrounded by national parks, there's ample opportunity to roam through nature on bush walks, kayak up the creek, swim, snorkel, surf or simply lounge with eyes out for wandering kangaroos and other wildlife. Feel like some pampering instead? Let reception book you a massage on your private deck and be lulled by the natural soundscape.

hotels.title: Stunning Jervis Bay Safari-Inspired Retreat just 2.5 Hours from Sydney
hotels.description: Retreat to the stunning Shoalhaven region south of Sydney and enjoy a serene stay at Paperbark Camp, an eco-friendly oasis perched along Currambene Creek that celebrates sustainability without sacrificing comfort. Retreat to this tranquil spot boasting just 13 safari-style canvas tents framed by eucalyptus trees then savour mouthwatering bush tucker at the treetop The Gunyah restaurant, enjoy a massage or laze the day as you explore Jervis Bay.
